comparison.objective: Candidate mounts a rack rail; record sharpens a pencil in a hand-crank sharpener and returns it to a rest.
comparison.physical_skill: Both require coordinated bimanual force and a later regrasp, but candidate aligns and latches a long rail while record maintains axial pencil pressure as the other hand cranks repeatedly.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four retained prongs and correct screws; record requires 24 mm cutting progress, pencil withdrawal, two-notch placement, release, and 1 s stability.
comparison.reason: Pressed rotary material removal tests a different ability from staged structural latching. Candidate insertion-force, fastening-torque, and damage thresholds are absent.
